## Projects

The portfolio site itself is the only live project. Five marketing automation systems are in the planning stage and are not running anywhere yet: LeadLens (AI lead enrichment and scoring for HubSpot), Creative Circuit (automated creative testing on the Meta Marketing API), Sentry (GA4/ads anomaly-detection Slack bot), Winback Engine (churn scoring feeding tiered win-back emails) and Tagworks (Slack-native UTM link factory). Plans at /projects.html.

## About this site

The portfolio itself is a live marketing instrument: GTM-native dataLayer with a 15-event documented schema, an on-page tracking console that mirrors and explains every event, a client-side audience segmentation engine, a running pre-registered A/B test on the hero headline (hero_headline_v1), UTM capture with on-page personalization, and a consent toggle implementing the Consent Mode pattern. Architecture documented at /colophon.html.
